title: What belongs on the poster?
instruction: A poster for the school dance has a single purpose: to make people stop and find out when and where. Mark what belongs on it.
debrief: A good poster is a model: it keeps only what serves the purpose. Everything else just drowns out what matters.

items.why: This is exactly what the viewer needs to find out.
The eye lands on one main thing.
More fonts mean chaos, not interest.

items.text: The evening’s programme minute by minute
items.why: Nobody reads that much text from the corridor. It belongs on the website or in a leaflet.

items.text: The name of the event in big letters
items.why: It has to be readable from a distance.

items.text: A list of everyone who helped with the decorations
items.why: A nice thank-you, but not on the poster.

items.text: Text in strong contrast to the background
items.why: Without contrast the text gets lost.
